title: Pearson and Spearman correlation with intervals
summary: Linear (Pearson) and rank (Spearman) correlation between two continuous measurements, each with a Fisher-z 95% interval.
pinned_defaults: R: cor.test gives no interval for Spearman; it is built on Fisher's z with the Fieller, Hartley and Pearson (1957) standard error 1.06 / sqrt(n - 3).
Python: pearsonr's confidence_interval (Fisher z); spearmanr gives none, so the same Fieller standard error is used.
_not_agreement: A correlation measures association. It is not agreement between two methods of measuring the same thing (two methods can correlate perfectly while one reads 10 units high); that needs Bland-Altman limits of agreement or an intraclass correlation.
